findings.claim: When configExists is false the message says 'pilot: true written into the generated config'. The help text (index.ts:101, index-lite.ts:117) says 'A config generated by this run gains pilot: true', the schema comment (config-schema.ts:721-722) says 'totem init --pilot writes true into a config it generates', and the changeset says whether pilot: true 'was written (only into a config the run generates)'.
findings.counterexample: For the totem.config.ts format the injection is a silent no-op. init.ts:1808 replaces with a regex anchored on a newline, a closing-brace-semicolon and then end of string. generateConfig (init-templates.ts:4079-4095) ends the file with a closing brace line followed by a blank line and 'export default config;', so the anchored regex never matches. The ts format is chosen for every repo with a package.json or TypeScript (init-detect.ts:147, 155-157), so this is the default JS/TS path, not an edge case. Reproduced in scratch with the worktree dist, which carries the fold text: an empty dir containing only package.json, then 'init --pilot --yes' printed 'Pilot flag recorded: pilot: true written into the generated config (a key nothing reads yet)', and the generated totem.config.ts has no pilot key. yaml (--bare) does get 'pilot: true'. The bug predates the fold (since 4eba48cb; the --strict injection at init.ts:1820-1824 uses the same regex and is broken the same way, out of scope). F1's fold added a positive per-run claim that is false on the default path, which is the same class read 1 F1 typed. Correcting fold: either branch the clause on whether the injected content differs from configContent, or word it 'pilot: true is written into a generated yaml or toml config; a generated totem.config.ts does not get it (mmnto-ai/totem#2815)'. Fixing the regex instead would be a behaviour change, and the changeset rules that out ('No gate or hook behaviour changes'); that is the seat's call.

findings.claim: The changeset still says the action gates installed with --gates 'run advisory'.
findings.counterexample: Read 1 F3 was folded in the help text, the init message and the schema comment ('a deny prints and exits 0; a gate that cannot be evaluated still blocks'), but not in the changeset's first sentence, which keeps 'which run advisory'. The wrapper exits 2 on every not-evaluable arm at every tier (init-templates.ts:1389-1390, 3067-3077, 3080-3089, 3121-3124). The changeset is the public release note. Correcting fold: one phrase.

findings.claim: stateExisted, from fs.existsSync on .totem/pilot-state.json, selects '.totem/pilot-state.json already present' and the summary row 'Pilot state already present'.
findings.counterexample: readPilotState (utils/pilot.ts:76-96) rewrites a file that exists but is invalid or unparseable. Reproduced in scratch: .totem/pilot-state.json containing 'garbage', then 'init --bare --pilot --yes' printed 'already present' and 'Pilot state already present', and the file was rewritten to a fresh {startedAt, pushCount: 0, violations: []}. This is narrow and cosmetic. Correcting fold: compare startedAt before and after, or say 'present (re-initialised if invalid)'.

findings.claim: '.totem/pilot-state.json records only the window's start and a push count'.
findings.counterexample: PilotState also holds a violations array (utils/pilot.ts:8-16, 89-93), and init writes it ('violations': [] in the scratch run). 'only' leaves out one field. Correcting fold: drop 'only', or add 'and an empty violations list'.

verdict: read 2 on 2329b6f0 (scoped to the fold of read 1): as typed, 0 BLOCKING, 1 MATERIAL, 3 MINOR, 0 QUESTION; held at source: configExists is the fresh-install branch's exact predicate; fs and path in scope; the --global warning fires before both early returns and log.warn exists; "a gate that cannot be evaluated still blocks" matches the wrapper's arms; config.pilot's only reader is the uncalled resolvePilotConfig; no test pins the old or new texts; the diff adds no behaviour beyond log lines and the summary row. F1 to F4 folded in 334d4109: the init message MEASURES whether the pilot injection changed the generated config (the .ts injection is a silent no-op today because its anchor expects the closing brace at end of file and the generated file ends with export default config; the same defect breaks the --strict injection; filed as mmnto-ai/totem#3083, a behaviour fix outside this register PR) and says which happened; the help text and the schema comment say a generated yaml or toml config gains the key and a generated totem.config.ts does not take it today; the state-file clause distinguishes initialised, already present and re-initialised after an invalid file by comparing the file's bytes before and after readPilotState; the changeset says the pilot tier beside the deny and unevaluable arms; the schema comment names the violations list. Read 3 is armed on the fold with the convergence question.
